note: Supports the interim minimal adjustment of Lethbridge East and West.

quote: I appreciate that my urban riding remain urban. I do not support hybridizing my riding with rural areas.
note: Place from header: Lethbridge, about Lethbridge-East.

quote: Coaldale is closely integrated into the Highway 3 corridor that links our town with Lethbridge, Taber, and the surrounding rural municipalities.
note: Coaldale resident wants Coaldale kept in its current district (Taber-Warner). Stresses regional systems centred on Lethbridge but makes no request to share a district with the city (rule 8).

quote: Thank you again for not carving up Lethbridge and tacking us onto rural areas.
I believe the proposed change to these two electoral divisions make sense and I agree with them.
note: "proper representation would not be served for either electorate by dividing Lethbridge up further".

quote: I do not support the notion that Lethbridge should be divided into three or four blended rural-urban style ridings.
note: Objects to the interim moving London Road to Lethbridge-East (wants 13th Street kept), so not a plain endorsement of the interim lines; in-city districts throughout. Same person as EBC-2025-1-0135.
